product_metadata.title: Goplus 7.5FT Pre-Lit Artificial Christmas Tree, Premium Hinged Spruce Tree, with LED Lights and Metal Stand, Easy Assemble, Perfect Xmas Decor for Home, Office and School
features: 🎄Hinged Design for Easy Setup -- This tree comes in all metal hinged construction (branches are attached to center pole sections) to make it easy for you to set up or dismantle.

🎄Pre-lit with 400 LED Lights -- Our pre-lit Christmas tree comes with 400 UL listed LED lights ,providing the ultra safety in use and shining lighting effect at nights. These LED lights are energy-saving and long lasting and its warm white color effectively strengthen the celebration atmosphere and highlight the Christmas themes.

🎄High-quality PVC Needles -- The eco-friendly PVC material is finely made into a natural and vivid evergreen tree. The crush-resistant tips are sculpted to enhance the tree’s appearance and prolong its serving time.
🎄Foldable Metal Stand -- A solid and foldable metal stand comes with the tree aims to provide more stability and keep your tree standing upright after over years of use.

🎄Convenient Versatility -- This 7.5 ft stereoscopic tree is an attractive addition for indoor decoration, especially for Christmas. Using it can get more festive atmosphere and add a touch of nature year-round. It is ideal for decorating home, office, shops, apartments and more.
